name: soft-key-goal
task: Grab the key, and after that get to the goal square if you can.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(has_key) hard is the commanded grab, and it is the lone commanded step, so it needs its own hard Existence. Precedence(has_key, at_goal) hard keeps the stated order 'after that'; the 'if you can' cue covers only the goal step, so the order stays hard. Existence(at_goal) soft matches the preference. No clause is redundant or added, and no door_open clause is needed because the environment already requires the door to open before the goal can be reached.

texts: Grab the key: the agent must carry the yellow key at some point during the episode.
After grabbing the key, get to the goal square: the goal square must not be reached before the key has been grabbed.
If you can, get to the goal square: the agent should reach the goal at some point. This is a soft preference and does not decide whether the task is finished.
